request.subject: CITY:GOBLIN:3

layers.text: Remove all ground: erase the grass and the brown soil slab under the camp, so the spiked iron fence, the tents and the huts stand directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under them. Keep the big red patched tent, the small red tents, the grey scrap-iron huts with red panels, the chimney pipes with grey smoke, the red flag, the spiked fence with its gate, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
